newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian court sentences cannibal to death --Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russian court sentences cannibal to death --Tass.

text.p: A Russian court on Thursday sentenced a man to death for killing and eating two people last winter, Itar-Tass news agency said.

Police who went to arrest the 38-year-old man found human remains in a frying pan, in the oven and on the balcony of his apartment in the town of Novocheboksarsk about 500 km (350 miles) east of Moscow.

During his trial the man had jokingly asked the authorities to prepare him a meal from the human remains he had been keeping on his balcony, Tass said. The man was calm and behaved in a normal way at the trial, it added.
His brother welcomed the court's verdict but the sister of one of the man's victims said she would have preferred him to rot away slowly in prison rather than to be quickly put to death.
